issues.on_page: Contributed Capital Revenue 570,994; Extraordinary Item - Settlement Expense (9,750,000)
issues.issue: The 9,750,000 extraordinary settlement expense is folded into other_financing. The rules put special/extraordinary items in adjustments, and other_financing is for capital contributions and asset sales. Better: other_financing 570,994 plus an adjustment of -9,750,000. The roll-forward holds either way.
